en.short: FTA-compliant tax invoices, simplified invoices, quotations and credit notes with 5% VAT and automatic numbering.
en.lede: Send an invoice a VAT-registered client can actually reclaim. Every mandatory field is on the page, the VAT is calculated for you, and the whole thing reads correctly in Arabic and English.
